title: Hindsight Structured Advice Distillation: Steering Executor Agents with Advisors Trained on Their Failures and Task Characteristics
title_zh: 事后结构化建议蒸馏：利用基于智能体失败案例与任务特征训练的顾问模型来引导执行智能体

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents now browse websites, query databases, call tools and write research reports [ 44 , 43 , 48 ] . In many deployments, the model at the core of the agent cannot be changed. It may be a closed model served through an API, a production agent shared by many teams, or a small open model that is cheap to serve and costly to re-validate after every change. Improving such a system therefore usually means changing what it is told rather than its weights.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体现在可以浏览网站、查询数据库、调用工具并撰写研究报告 [ 44 , 43 , 48 ] 。 在许多部署场景中，智能体核心的模型无法更改。 它可能是一个通过 API 提供的闭源模型，一个由多个团队共享的生产环境智能体，或者是一个服务成本低但每次修改后重新验证成本高昂的小型开源模型。 因此，改进此类系统通常意味着改变其接收的指令，而非调整其权重。

sents.en: Improving such a system therefore usually means changing what it is told rather than its weights.

paragraphs.en: What the agent needs to be told is often know-how about the task rather than general ability. For example, a financial research agent may be asked for a company’s quarterly revenue by product category when the company publishes only each category’s percentage share of sales, not its revenue in dollars. An agent that does not know this may fill the table with its own estimates, when the better answer reports the percentages and states that dollar figures are not disclosed. A shopping agent may buy the right shirt in the wrong size, because it did not work out which option buttons the instruction required. In both cases, the agent has the knowledge and the tools it needs. It is missing a detail of how this kind of task should be done, and that detail differs from one input to the next.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体需要被告知的内容，通常是对任务的具体操作知识，而非一般性能力。 例如，当一家公司仅公布各产品类别的销售百分比份额，而未披露其美元收入时，财务研究智能体可能会被要求按产品类别列出该公司的季度收入。 不了解这一点的智能体可能会用自己的估算值来填写表格，而更恰当的回答则是报告这些百分比，并说明具体金额并未公开。 购物智能体可能会买对衬衫但尺码错误，因为它未能判断出选项按钮中哪个符合指令要求。 在这两种情况下，智能体都具备所需的知识与工具。 它缺少的是这类任务应如何执行的具体细节，而这些细节会因输入内容不同而有所差异。

paragraphs.en: There are two usual ways to supply such know-how. The first is to train the agent. Reinforcement learning (RL) is now a standard way to train language agents [ 48 ] , but it is expensive when every rollout takes minutes and the reward is a rubric score, and it is not an option when the agent’s weights are fixed. The second is to write the know-how into the agent’s prompt, and a large body of work optimizes such prompts automatically [ 55 , 42 , 19 , 45 , 1 , 50 ] . However, most of these methods produce one prompt or context for a whole task. The prompt grows long as it covers more cases, and much of it applies to only some inputs. Per-input steering also exists, for example a small policy model that writes a hint for each input [ 23 ] , or an advisor model trained with RL to write per-instance advice for a black-box model [ 4 ] . These methods still leave open what the advice should contain and where its training signal should come from.
paragraphs.zh: 提供这类专业知识通常有两种方法。 第一种方法是训练智能体。 强化学习（RL）如今已成为训练语言智能体的标准方法 [ 48 ]，但当每次运行需要数分钟且奖励是评分标准时，这种方法成本高昂；而当智能体的权重固定时，它更是一种不可行的选择。 第二种方法是将专业知识写入智能体的提示中，大量研究致力于自动优化这类提示 [ 55 , 42 , 19 , 45 , 1 , 50 ]。 然而，这些方法大多只为整个任务生成一个提示或上下文。 随着需要涵盖更多情况，提示会变得越来越长，而其中大部分内容仅适用于部分输入。 也存在针对单个输入的引导方法，例如：为每个输入生成提示的小型策略模型 [ 23 ]，或通过强化学习训练、能为黑箱模型提供实例级建议的顾问模型 [ 4 ]。 但这些方法仍未解决建议应包含哪些内容，以及其训练信号应来自何处的问题。

paragraphs.en: We argue that hindsight can supply that signal. After the fact, on a training input with a graded answer, it is often easy to see what would have helped. The shopping episode above, for instance, shows that the agent needed to be told which size button to click. Hindsight relabeling has a long history in RL [ 3 ] , in instruction following [ 51 ] , and in reasoning [ 46 ] . It is also the core of learning with privileged information, where a teacher that sees information unavailable at test time trains a student that does not [ 26 , 11 , 22 ] . Recent work in this line distills the privileged teacher into the agent itself. We distill it into a separate small advisor instead, which leaves the agent unchanged and is cheap to train and to run. With this approach, the student must be able to infer, from its own inputs, what the teacher inferred with the privileged information, or the transfer fails [ 11 , 56 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，事后回顾可以提供这种信号。 事后来看，对于一个带有分级答案的训练输入，通常很容易看出哪些信息会有所帮助。 例如，上面的购物案例表明，智能体需要被告知应该点击哪个尺寸的按钮。 在强化学习 [ 3 ]、指令遵循 [ 51 ] 和推理 [ 46 ] 领域，事后重标签化已有悠久的历史。 这也是特权信息学习的核心：教师能看到测试时无法获取的信息，并据此训练一个无法看到这些信息的学生 [ 26 , 11 , 22 ]。 该领域的近期研究将特权教师的知识提炼到智能体本身中。 而我们将这种知识提炼到一个独立的小型顾问中，这样既保持了智能体的不变性，又使训练和运行成本较低。 采用这种方法，学生必须能够根据自身的输入推断出教师借助特权信息所推断出的内容，否则知识迁移就会失败 [ 11 , 56 ]。

paragraphs.en: We call the resulting approach hindsight structured advice distillation (HSAD), shown in Fig. 1. At test time, we have a small trained advisor in front of a frozen executor (similar to [ 23 , 4 ] ), and we train the advisor by hindsight distillation. The training targets come from hindsight, what is distilled into the student model is advice, and the advisor writes that advice as a structured output (JSON) whose fields take values from closed vocabularies. First, we analyse the frozen executor’s failures on a training pool and mine two vocabularies from them: a small set of arms , which are whole-response strategies appended to the executor’s base prompt, and a two-level directive taxonomy of error areas and specific fixes. Second, we run the executor under every arm on every training input, grade the answers, and record which arm won. Third, a teacher writes the advice that would have helped most. The teacher combines an LLM, which sees the input, the grading, every arm’s answer with its score and tool usage, the winning trace, and the closed vocabularies to choose from, with fixed rules that fill the fields that can be read off the runs or the input. Fourth, we train a small advisor by supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to write that advice from the input alone. At test time, this advice is rendered as text and appended to the executor prompt, where it acts as guidance that the executor is free to follow or ignore.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将由此产生的方法称为“事后结构化建议蒸馏”（hindsight structured advice distillation，简称 HSAD），如图 1 所示。 在测试阶段，我们有一个经过训练的小型顾问与一个冻结的执行器配合（类似于 [23, 4]），并通过事后蒸馏来训练该顾问。 训练目标来自事后分析；被蒸馏到学生模型中的是建议，而顾问则将这些建议以结构化输出（JSON）的形式写出，其字段值均取自封闭词汇表。 首先，我们分析冻结执行器在训练数据集上的失败情况，并从中提取两个词汇表：一个由“动作”组成的小型集合（这些动作是附加在执行器基础提示词上的完整响应策略），以及一个包含错误领域和具体修复方法的二级指令分类体系。 其次，我们对每个训练输入，使用所有“动作”运行执行器，对结果进行评分，并记录哪个“动作”获胜。 第三步，由一个教师模型写出最有帮助的建议。 该教师模型结合了一个大型语言模型（LLM），后者能够看到输入、评分结果、每个“动作”的响应及其得分与工具使用情况、获胜轨迹以及可供选择的封闭词汇表，并依据固定规则填写那些可从运行结果或输入中直接读取的字段。 第四步，我们通过监督微调（SFT）训练一个小型顾问，使其仅根据输入就能写出上述建议。 在测试阶段，这些建议会被转换为文本并附加到执行器的提示词中，作为执行器可以自由遵循或忽略的指导信息。

paragraphs.en: Our main setting is FrontierFinance, a public benchmark of 220 expert-written financial research queries graded against more than eleven thousand source-attributed rubric items [ 52 ] . Its report finds that the harness (tools, prompts and so on) and the executor model strongly shape quality, and that Samaya’s proprietary research agent leads all evaluated systems. We take that agent as the frozen executor and ask whether a small advisor can still improve it. On the public leaderboard, the advised agent reaches a 56.6% qualification rate, against 52.9% without advice and 56.0% for the agent’s own high-effort configuration, at 37% lower cost per query than that configuration. We then apply HSAD with a small frozen Qwen3-4B executor [ 41 ] in three further settings: WebShop [ 43 ] , a simulated shopping environment; BIRD text-to-SQL [ 21 ] ; and ExpertLongBench [ 32 ] , a set of expert-level long-form generation tasks. On WebShop, the score rises from 54.6 to 63.4 and the success rate increases from 3.8% to 23.2% on 500 held-out samples. On BIRD and ExpertLongBench, the gains are +3.1 execution-accuracy points and +4.9 checklist-coverage points, respectively. These results suggest that the approach carries over to other executors and domains.

paragraphs.en: (1) We propose HSAD, a supervised approach that learns from a frozen executor’s traces, through error analysis and hindsight labels, and distills what it learns into a small advisor that writes structured, input-specific guidance. (2) We make explicit where each training label comes from, and show that both the judgments of the teacher’s LLM and the labels its rules compute from the runs are useful. (3) We distinguish three reference points for how much advice can help. The first is the best strategy for each input as recorded during collection (best-arm oracle), the second is the score when the teacher’s advice, or only its arm, is given to the executor in a new run, and the third is the score with the trained advisor’s advice (the student’s performance). (4) We show that a small advisor lifts a proprietary, leaderboard-leading research agent above its own high-effort configuration on the public FrontierFinance benchmark, and we report gains in three further settings with a small open executor.

paragraphs.en: Several lines of work keep a large model fixed and train a smaller one to influence it. Directional stimulus prompting trains a small policy model, first with SFT and then with RL, to write an instance-specific hint that is added to a black-box model’s prompt [ 23 ] . Proxy tuning steers a large model at decoding time by adding the logit difference between a small tuned model and its untuned version [ 25 ] , which requires access to the large model’s output distribution. Planner–executor splits divide an agent into a model that plans and a model that acts, either within a multi-LLM tool-use agent [ 34 ] or with a separately trained planner for long-horizon web tasks [ 12 ] . Advisor models [ 4 ] train a small open-weight advisor with reinforcement learning, on rewards computed from the black-box model’s outputs, to write per-instance natural-language advice for that model, and report that an advisor trained with a low-cost student model transfers its improvements to a frontier model. Plan-and-Solve prompting asks a single model to write a plan before solving [ 39 ] , and DIN-SQL decomposes text-to-SQL into schema linking, query classification and decomposition, SQL generation and self-correction steps [ 31 ] . Several of our mined arms resemble such fixed decompositions, for example BIRD’s schema-grounding and CTE-decomposition arms. Weak-to-strong generalization studies the related question of whether a weaker supervisor can elicit a stronger model’s capabilities [ 6 ] . HSAD keeps the split between a small trained advisor and a frozen executor. It differs from these methods in three ways. First, the advisor is trained by supervised fine-tuning on hindsight targets. Second, the advice is a structured object whose fields take values from closed vocabularies, rather than free text. Third, those vocabularies, and the labels for which strategy helped, come from error analysis of the executor’s own failures and task characteristics and from running the executor under different strategies utilizing the training data.

paragraphs.en: Automatic prompt engineering searches over instructions with a language model as the proposer [ 55 , 42 ] , and DSPy compiles declarative pipelines by optimizing their prompts and demonstrations [ 19 ] . TextGrad treats textual feedback as a gradient [ 45 ] , and GEPA evolves prompts by reflecting on rollouts [ 1 ] . Context-engineering methods keep an evolving playbook or memory across tasks, for example ACE’s generation–reflection–curation loop [ 50 ] , Dynamic Cheatsheet’s persistent test-time memory [ 38 ] , and experience or workflow memories mined from past trajectories [ 53 , 40 , 13 ] . Self-Refine has the model critique and revise its own output [ 27 ] , and Reflexion has an agent keep verbal reflections on failed trials in memory for later attempts [ 35 ] . Early experience trains an agent on the consequences of its own exploratory actions, without a reward signal, and reports gains over imitation learning across eight environments [ 49 ] . These methods optimize a context that is shared across inputs or accumulated over time. Our arms and directive taxonomy are also a mined, shared vocabulary, but the choice among them, and the values filled into them, are made per input by a trained small model.

paragraphs.en: Adaptive-RAG trains a small classifier to predict a question’s complexity and routes it to no retrieval, single-step retrieval, or multi-step retrieval [ 17 ] . RouteLLM and FrugalGPT route queries between models of different cost [ 29 , 10 ] . The arm field of our advice is a router in this sense, and its labels come from running every arm, as in these works. Routing alone, however, leaves gains on the table. A routing decision helps only as much as the predicted best arm is right, and predicting it from the input alone is itself a hard problem. Even with good routing, our results show further gains from the other fields of the advice, which tell the executor what to cover and where to look.
paragraphs.zh: Adaptive-RAG 训练一个小型分类器来预测问题的复杂程度，并将其转接到无检索、单步检索或多步检索流程中 [ 17 ] 。 RouteLLM 和 FrugalGPT 在不同成本的模型之间对查询进行路由 [ 29 , 10 ] 。 从这个意义上说，我们建议中的“臂”字段就是一个路由器，其标签来自运行每个“臂”，正如这些研究中所做的那样。 然而，仅靠路由本身仍会错失一些潜在收益。 路由决策的效用仅限于预测的最佳“臂”是否正确，而仅根据输入预测这一结果本身就是一个难题。 即使路由效果良好，我们的结果表明，建议中的其他字段还能带来进一步收益，这些字段会告诉执行者需要覆盖哪些内容以及应查找哪些位置。

paragraphs.en: Hindsight experience replay relabels a failed trajectory with the goal it actually achieved, which turns sparse-reward failures into useful training data [ 3 ] . Hindsight instruction relabeling brings the idea to instruction following by relabeling outputs with the instruction they satisfy [ 51 ] . For language agents, recent work relabels agent trajectories in hindsight to create successful demonstrations [ 24 ] , and uses hindsight over explored experience to create training tasks for web agents [ 28 ] . Our labels are hindsight labels of a different kind. We keep the task fixed and relabel which strategy, and which advice, would have made the frozen executor succeed.
paragraphs.zh: 事后经验重放会将一条失败的轨迹重新标记为它实际达成的目标，从而将稀疏奖励下的失败转化为有用的训练数据 [ 3 ] 。 事后指令重标记将这一思路延伸至指令遵循任务中，通过根据输出所满足的指令对其进行重新标记 [ 51 ] 。 对于语言智能体，近期的研究通过事后重新标记智能体的轨迹来生成成功的演示 [ 24 ] ，并利用对已探索经验的事后分析为网络智能体创建训练任务 [ 28 ] 。 我们的标签是另一种类型的事后标签。 我们保持任务不变，而是重新标记出哪种策略和哪种建议本能使被冻结的执行器成功。

paragraphs.en: In learning with privileged information, a teacher sees extra information during training, and a student learns to do well without it. This setting is closely related to knowledge distillation [ 26 ] . Context distillation trains a model to give, without a prompt, the answers it gave with the prompt [ 5 , 37 ] . STaR shows a model the correct answer, has it write a rationale for that answer, and trains on the rationale [ 46 ] . The idea has long been used to train agents. In Learning by Cheating, a driving agent that sees the ground-truth state of the scene teaches a student that sees only camera images [ 9 ] . Several recent methods apply it to language-model agents. π \pi -Distill trains a teacher that sees privileged information and a student that does not within one model, and uses it to distill frontier agents in multi-turn environments [ 30 ] . In LEAP, the teachers can see the environment’s hidden state [ 11 ] . In gated hindsight distillation, the teacher of a mobile GUI agent also sees the next screenshot, and distillation is applied only when the student fails and the teacher recovers the correct action [ 22 ] . Showing the teacher the answer does not always help the student. A teacher that sees a reference answer can pull its targets toward that reference [ 15 ] , and in controlled comparisons the correct reference does not help consistently [ 36 ] . On-policy self-distillation trains one model as both a teacher that sees privileged information and a student that does not, on the student’s own outputs [ 54 ] . A study of the method finds that it works when the privileged information is a rule shared across inputs, such as a system prompt, and fails when that information is specific to one input, such as the answer to one problem [ 56 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在有特权信息的学习中，教师智能体在训练期间能看到额外信息，而学生智能体则要学会在没有这些信息的情况下表现良好。 这种设置与知识蒸馏 [ 26 ] 密切相关。 上下文蒸馏训练模型能够在没有提示的情况下给出原本需要提示才能给出的答案 [ 5 , 37 ] 。 STaR 方法会向模型展示正确答案，要求它为该答案撰写推理过程，然后基于该推理过程进行训练 [ 46 ] 。 这一理念长期以来一直被用于训练智能体。 在“通过作弊学习”方法中，一个能看到场景真实状态的驾驶智能体会教导一个仅能看到摄像头图像的学生智能体 [ 9 ] 。 近期有多种方法将其应用于语言模型智能体。π \pi -Distill 方法在一个模型内同时训练能看到特权信息的教师智能体和看不到的学生智能体，并利用该方法在多轮环境中蒸馏前沿智能体 [ 30 ] 。 在 LEAP 方法中，教师智能体能看到环境的隐藏状态 [ 11 ] 。 在门控回溯蒸馏中，移动 GUI 智能体的教师智能体还能看到下一张屏幕截图，且仅在学生智能体失败而教师智能体成功恢复正确动作时才会应用蒸馏 [ 22 ] 。 向教师智能体展示答案并不总能帮助学生智能体。 能看到参考答案的教师智能体可能会将其目标向该参考答案靠拢 [ 15 ] ，但在受控对比实验中，正确的参考答案并未始终起到帮助作用 [ 36 ] 。 在线策略自蒸馏方法将同一模型同时训练为能看到特权信息的教师智能体和看不到的学生智能体，并以学生智能体自身的输出作为训练数据 [ 54 ] 。 对该方法的一项研究发现：当特权信息是跨输入共享的规则（例如系统提示）时，该方法有效；而当该信息针对特定输入（例如某个问题的答案）时，该方法则失效 [ 56 ] 。

paragraphs.en: HSAD uses the gold answer and the executor’s traces as privileged information. It differs from the methods above in two ways. The student is a separate small model rather than the agent, and it learns to write advice rather than to execute. The difference between shared rules and input-specific facts also matches what we observe. What the advisor learns from the traces, such as which directive fixes which kind of failure, is a rule shared across inputs, and the advisor learns it well. An input-specific fact helps only when the advisor can read it from the input. We therefore build the input-specific fields of the advice around information that the input states, such as the options listed in a shopping instruction. To our knowledge, HSAD is the first method to distill hindsight advice, built from a frozen executor’s own failures, into a separate small advisor that writes structured, per-input advice.
paragraphs.zh: HSAD 将黄金答案和执行者的轨迹作为特权信息使用。 它与上述方法在两个方面有所不同。 学生是一个独立的小型模型，而非智能体，并且它学习的是如何撰写建议，而非执行操作。 共享规则与输入特定事实之间的区别也与我们观察到的情况一致。 建议者从轨迹中学到的内容，例如哪项指令能解决哪种类型的失败，是一种跨输入共享的规则，而建议者能够很好地掌握这一规则。 输入特定事实只有在建议者能够从输入中读取它时才有用。 因此，我们在建议的输入特定字段中构建基于输入所陈述的信息，例如购物说明中列出的选项。 据我们所知，HSAD 是第一种将事后建议——这些建议基于一个已冻结的执行者自身的失败——提炼成一个独立的小型建议者的方法，该建议者能够针对每个输入撰写结构化的建议。

paragraphs.en: The first stage studies how the executor fails, so that the advice can later be written in terms of those failures. We run the executor with its base prompt over the training pool and grade each output against gold. For each failed input, a strong model writes a short free-text note on what went wrong, without being given any categories. The model sees the input, the executor’s output and its grade, together with whatever else explains the failure. For text-to-SQL, for example, it also sees the database schema and the execution error, since an error such as “no such column” often points straight to the mistake. We then cluster the notes from thousands of failed inputs into a closed vocabulary. Writing the notes before choosing any categories improves the quality of the vocabulary, since every category comes from failures the executor made on training inputs and every directive addresses one of them.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段研究执行器如何失败，以便后续能够根据这些失败情况编写建议。 我们在训练数据集上运行执行器及其基础提示，并将每个输出与标准答案进行评分。 对于每个失败的输入，一个强模型会撰写一段简短的自由文本说明问题所在，且不提供任何分类选项。 模型会看到输入、执行器的输出及其评分，以及任何有助于解释失败的其他信息。 例如，在文本转 SQL 任务中，模型还会看到数据库模式和执行错误，因为“不存在该列”之类的错误通常能直接指出问题所在。 随后，我们将数千个失败输入所产生的说明聚类到一个封闭词汇表中。 在选择任何分类之前撰写这些说明，能够提升词汇表的质量，因为每个分类都源于执行器在训练输入中出现的失败，而每条指令都针对其中一种失败情况。

paragraphs.en: Two vocabularies come out of this stage (Fig. 2). Arms are three to eight whole-response strategies, each a short delta of a few sentences, plus a default arm that adds nothing. An arm must add to the base prompt rather than replace it. Otherwise an arm-versus-arm comparison mixes the strategy with incidental rewording of the base instruction. Directives form a two-level taxonomy with error areas at the first level and specific, named fixes at the second, for example area 7 of BIRD, “dialect and type casting”, with directive 7.1 cast_operands_to_real_before_division in the text-to-SQL taxonomy of Fig. 2. The size of each vocabulary depends on the task (Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这一阶段会产生两个词汇表（图 2）。 各个分支包含三到八种完整响应策略，每种策略由几句简短的增量内容组成，此外还有一个不添加任何内容的默认分支。 分支必须对基础提示进行补充，而非替换它。 否则，分支之间的比较会将策略与基础指令中附带的内容改写混为一谈。 指令构成一个两级分类体系：第一级是错误区域，第二级是具体且命名的修复方法。例如，BIRD 中的区域 7“方言和类型转换”，在图 2 的文本转 SQL 分类体系中对应指令 7.1“在除法前将操作数转换为实数”。 每个词汇表的大小取决于具体任务（表 2）。

paragraphs.en: The second stage produces the hindsight label. We run the frozen executor under every arm on every training input, grade every output against gold, and record the winning arm a ⋆ ​ ( x ) a^{\star}(x) together with its trace. Some rows produce ties, because several arms often give the same score, and the tie-break is part of the label definition. We break ties toward default . If no arm beats doing nothing, the correct advice is to change nothing, and training the advisor to fire an arm on such rows teaches it to intervene without benefit. When scores have several dimensions, ties can be broken by a fixed fallback order of secondary criteria. If every arm fails, or several arms tie and the scores cannot separate them, the teacher’s LLM, which sees the gold answer and every arm’s output, can pick the arm whose output is closest to correct. Section 4 gives the scheme used in each setting, and Appendix C.1 gives examples of how the tie-break changes the advisor.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段生成事后标签。 我们在每个训练输入上运行每个分支的冻结执行器，将每个输出与黄金标准进行评分，并记录获胜分支 a ⋆ ​ ( x ) a^{\star}(x) 及其轨迹。 某些行会出现平局，因为多个分支经常给出相同的分数，而破平规则是标签定义的一部分。 我们在出现平局时选择默认选项。 如果没有分支优于“什么都不做”，正确的建议就是保持不变；在类似行中训练顾问触发某个分支，会使其学会在不产生收益的情况下进行干预。 当分数具有多个维度时，可以通过固定的次级标准备用顺序来破平。 如果所有分支都失败，或者多个分支出现平局且分数无法区分它们，那么能够看到黄金答案和每个分支输出的教师 LLM，可以选择输出最接近正确答案的分支。 第 4 节介绍了每种设置中使用的方案，附录 C.1 提供了破平规则如何改变顾问的示例。

paragraphs.en: The third stage writes the advice target z ⋆ ​ ( x ) z^{\star}(x) for every training input. This is the signal that the advisor will learn to produce. The teacher is the labelling procedure that has hindsight access to gold and to the runs. It combines an LLM, for fields that need judgment, with fixed rules, for fields whose value can be read off the arm scores, the winner’s trace or the input. The teacher’s LLM receives the input and its grading material (the gold answer or a grading rubric), every arm’s output with its score and tool usage, and the full trace of the winning arm. It also receives the closed vocabularies it must choose from: the arms, the directive taxonomy and, where relevant, the values of other fields (e.g., the list of data sources). It then fills a domain-specific JSON schema whose fields are illustrated in Fig. 3 and listed in Table 1 . The schema is designed before any LLM call, and the LLM does not fill every field. The quality of this schema matters a great deal for the results. For a new task, iterations on failure analysis and on alternative schemas therefore pay off.

paragraphs.en: Every training label has two properties: how the teacher computes it and what it is computed from. It is computed either by one of the teacher’s fixed rules ( rule-based ) or by the teacher’s LLM ( LLM reasoning ). It is computed from the input alone, from the gold answer, or from the executor’s runs. From the runs, a rule can read either the arm scores, meaning the grader’s score of every arm’s output against gold, or the winner’s trace, meaning the run of the winning arm. Everything except the input is available only in hindsight. Table 1 gives both properties for every field we use.

paragraphs.en: The same field can often be obtained in either way. Answer length, for example, can be computed by a rule from the winner’s trace or estimated by the teacher’s LLM. We adopted this rule after finding that the LLM’s estimates can disagree with the runs (§ 5.4 ). The arm is always the hindsight winner, and the LLM picks it only when the scores cannot separate the arms.

paragraphs.en: The teacher’s LLM sees the gold answer, so the advice it writes must not leak that answer, for example by naming the value the answer should contain. We prevent this in how the vocabularies are built and used. When we mine a directive taxonomy, the prompt requires every directive to be a generic behaviour that applies across many inputs, with no entity, date, period or value in it, and candidates that name one are rewritten or dropped. When the teacher’s LLM writes an advice target, it only picks among these fixed values, and the executor receives the fixed description of each picked directive. The advice therefore contains no free text written with the gold answer in view.
paragraphs.zh: 教师的 LLM 能够看到标准答案，因此它撰写的建议不得泄露该答案，例如不能提及答案应包含的具体数值。 我们通过构建和使用词汇表的方式防止这种情况发生。 在挖掘指令分类体系时，提示词要求每个指令都是一种适用于多种输入的通用行为，其中不得包含任何实体、日期、时间范围或数值；若候选指令中出现了这些内容，则会被改写或舍弃。 当教师的 LLM 撰写建议目标时，它仅从这些固定值中进行选择，而执行者则会收到每个被选中指令的固定描述。 因此，这些建议中不包含任何在知晓标准答案的情况下撰写的自由文本。

paragraphs.en: The fourth stage trains the advisor by supervised fine-tuning. Each training example pairs an input with the teacher’s advice target for it. The advisor is a small open model that learns to produce the JSON target from the input and a system prompt that lists the schema and vocabularies. It never sees gold. Because it is small, it is cheap to train, and running it adds one low latency model call per input. We select the epoch by paired lift on a held-out validation split, running the executor with each checkpoint’s advice, rather than by the agreement between the advisor’s JSON and the targets (see Appendix C.1 for more details).
paragraphs.zh: 第四阶段通过监督微调来训练顾问智能体。 每个训练示例都将一个输入与教师智能体针对该输入的推荐目标进行配对。 顾问智能体是一个小型开放模型，它通过从输入和列出模式与词汇表的系统提示中学习生成 JSON 目标。它从未接触过黄金标准数据。 由于模型规模较小，其训练成本较低，且运行该模型时每条输入只需一次低延迟的模型调用。 我们通过保留验证集上的成对提升效果来选择训练轮次，即使用每个检查点的推荐通过执行器运行，而不是依据顾问智能体的 JSON 输出与目标之间的匹配度（更多细节请参见附录 C.1）。

The arm contributes its strategy delta, effort and length become one sentence each (“Plan for 6 or more tool calls in total.”), and each directive contributes its one-sentence description. The rendered text is appended to the executor’s prompt or message list, as guidance that the executor is free to follow or ignore.

paragraphs.en: FrontierFinance is a public benchmark of 220 expert-written financial research queries, graded against 11,543 source-attributed rubric items that span six use cases of an investor’s workflow, from earnings and events to screening and discovery [ 52 ] . Each query has its own rubric, and some rubric items are marked essential. The metric is the qualification rate, the fraction of rubric items an answer satisfies, averaged over queries. We report it for all items, as the public leaderboard does, and separately for essential items. Our executor is Samaya’s production research agent, which leads the benchmark’s leaderboard [ 52 ] , with tools over financial filings, market-data services and the web. We freeze it and try to improve it only through advice. Its four arms are default , structured_priority (prefer structured and tabular data tools), tables_extraction (extract figures from filing tables), and restricted_tools (structured sources only, no web search). Ties between arms are broken by a fallback order: essential criteria, then all criteria, then cost, then latency. The advisor is trained on 1,819 questions from the same expert-annotated pool that FrontierFinance was drawn from, none of which is among the 220 public queries. It is evaluated on a separate held-out validation set and on the 220 public queries, which serve as the test set.

paragraphs.en: BIRD is a text-to-SQL benchmark of 12,751 question–SQL pairs over 95 databases [ 21 ] . The metric is execution accuracy, the fraction of questions whose predicted query returns the same result as the gold query. The executor is a frozen Qwen3-4B that writes one query per question. The training pool is BIRD’s training split (9,428 questions over 69 databases). We split BIRD’s development set into 460 questions for epoch selection and 1,074 for test. Because many training questions have several correct arms or none, the teacher’s LLM, which sees the gold query and every arm’s query and result, picks the arm closest to correct.

paragraphs.en: ExpertLongBench is a benchmark of expert-level long-form tasks, each with a rubric designed or validated by domain experts [ 32 ] . Outputs are graded by extracting a checklist of the rubric’s items from the output and comparing it with the checklist extracted from a reference. We use six of its public tasks: materials-science synthesis extraction (T03), pedagogical evaluation of tutoring dialogues (T04), clinical note generation (T06), molecule and protein description generation (T07, T08) and security review of agent trajectories (T11). We exclude the seventh public task (legal multi-document summarization), whose source documents have a median length of about 62K tokens. The metric is the fraction of checklist fields an answer satisfies. The executor is a frozen Qwen3-4B. It has 450 training and 100 test documents.

paragraphs.en: The finance setting asks whether a small advisor can still improve a system that is already strong. The executor leads the benchmark’s leaderboard, and its harness was built for this kind of research, so any gain has to come from advice that the agent does not already give itself. paragraphs.zh: 财务设置询问的是，一个小型顾问是否仍然能够改进一个已经非常强大的系统。 执行器主导着基准测试的排行榜，其框架正是为这类研究而构建的，因此任何进步都必须来自智能体尚未自行提供的建议。 每次运行智能体大约需要四分钟并花费约一美元，因此，在 1,819 个训练问题中收集“臂”是整个流程中最昂贵的步骤。

paragraphs.en: The advice has six fields (Fig. 3). The arm is the hindsight winner strategy. The teacher’s LLM writes target_length (short, medium or long, with fixed page counts for each category), web_use ( avoid , fallback or required ), a prioritized list of data sources , a list of suggested tools , and directive_picks drawn from a 103-directive taxonomy in 9 areas (for example 3.1 cover_all_named_entities_in_query ). To write these fields, the LLM sees each training question’s rubric, the four arms’ answers with their rubric scores, tool calls and costs, and the tool-call trace of the winning arm. The rendered advice is appended to the query as a guidance block (Appendix A.2 ). It is phrased as a suggestion, with an explicit fallback to the agent’s own exploration when needed.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares the performance of the advised agent against the leaderboard’s entries. The leaderboard’s Samaya System entry is the same agent without advice. With the advisor, the agent’s qualification rate rises from 52.9% to 56.6%. This is above the Samaya System’s high-effort configuration (56.0%), which adds improved tools, stronger context management and more reasoning effort, and above the best frontier model in the open finance-agent harness (Claude Fable 5.1, 55.9%). The advised agent costs $1.14 per query, against $0.93 without advice, $1.81 for the high-effort configuration and $6.89 for Claude Fable 5.1. Fig. 4 shows the same comparison as a cost–quality trade-off. The advisor moves the Samaya System up to the top of the leaderboard while staying in the low-cost region, where every other system of similar cost, apart from the unadvised agent itself, scores at least ten points lower. paragraphs.en: To find out which fields carry the gain, we ran a leave-one-field-out ablation on the validation set. paragraphs.en: To find what the arms were missing, we measured where the lost reward went. Across the 5,927 training samples where even the best arm fell short of full reward, 69% of the lost reward came from missed options, 18% from attributes, 10% from product type and 3% from search or commitment failures. The executor could search and it could click, but it often did not work out which option buttons the instruction required. A generic directive, “inspect all option buttons and click every required one”, did not help. An instantiated one did. Parsing the option values from the instruction and rendering them as “Before clicking Buy Now you MUST click the size button labelled ‘x-large’; …” raised score by 8.9 points on validation. The option values are stated verbatim in the instruction, and a regular expression recovers these values for every sample. Rendering the values as click instructions removes the extraction step, and the executor only has to click the named buttons.
paragraphs.zh: 为了找出各个智能体缺少了什么，我们测量了丢失的奖励都去了哪里。 在 5,927 个训练样本中，即使表现最佳的智能体也未能获得完整奖励；其中 69% 的丢失奖励来自未选中的选项，18% 来自属性问题，10% 来自产品类型，3% 则源于搜索或确认失败。 执行者能够进行搜索和点击，但常常无法确定指令要求的是哪些选项按钮。 一条通用指令“检查所有选项按钮并点击每个必需的按钮”并未奏效，而一条具体实例化的指令却有效了。 从指令中解析选项值，并将其呈现为“在点击‘立即购买’之前，您必须点击标有‘x-large’的尺寸按钮；……”，使验证得分提升了 8.9 分。 选项值在指令中以原文形式明确给出，并且一个正则表达式可以从每个样本中提取这些值。 将选项值直接呈现为点击指令，省去了提取步骤，执行者只需点击指定名称的按钮即可。

paragraphs.en: Our test set is WebShop’s standard 500 test instructions, the same set used by ReAct [ 44 ] , so the scores are comparable, although the agent harnesses differ. paragraphs.en: On BIRD, advice must steer a single SQL generation, and the most useful knowledge is which tables, columns and joins the question needs. This is harder for an advisor than WebShop’s options, because it is not stated in the question, and in our setup the BIRD advisor sees only the question and its evidence hint, not the database schema.

paragraphs.en: The trained advisor raises execution accuracy from 40.04% to 43.11% on the 1,074 test questions. Appendix C.4 compares the result against the three reference points. The best arm recorded during collection would add 20.11 points, running each question again with its best arm adds 11.27, and the student captures about 27% of the executed ceiling. By the advisor’s chosen arm, the largest gains are on schema_grounding_and_minimal_joins (+7.98 on 188 questions) and strict_projection_and_output_alignment (+13.16 on 38). One example query is the following: “What is the average score of the posts owned by the user csgillespie?” The executor without advice filters on a denormalized display-name column of the posts table and returns the wrong answer. With the advice of Fig. 3 (schema grounding, “join descriptive tables for named entities”) it joins the users table on the owner’s identifier and filters on users.DisplayName , which matches the gold result. Another pattern is dialect. Given “how many badges … were obtained in the year 2011”, the executor wrote YEAR(Date) = 2011 , which SQLite does not support, and the advice “use dialect-compatible date functions” led it to strftime(’%Y’, Date) = ’2011’ .

paragraphs.en: We also analysed the advisor’s own errors on the test set (Appendix C.4 ). When the advice hurts, it is usually because the executor applies a directive where it does not fit, for example by adding an unneeded join. When the executor answers a question wrongly both with and without advice, an existing directive already covers the root cause in 94% of the cases we inspected. The remaining gap therefore lies mostly in choosing and applying directives, and few failures point to a missing strategy. The advised executor can be compared with published work, although published BIRD results use the full development set or the hidden test set, while ours use a 1,074-question subset of the development set, so comparisons are approximate. The advised Qwen3-4B executor performs comparably to what BIRD’s authors report for ChatGPT on the test set with external knowledge (39.3%, or 40.1% with chain-of-thought prompting) [ 21 ] , and below DIN-SQL (55.9% on the test set) [ 31 ] , which prompts GPT-4 to solve the task in separate steps (schema linking, query classification and SQL generation) and then to correct its own query.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还分析了顾问在测试集上自身的错误（附录 C.4）。 当建议产生负面影响时，通常是因为执行者在不适合的情况下应用了某个指令，例如添加了一个不必要的连接操作。 当执行者在有建议和没有建议的情况下都回答错误时，在我们检查的 94% 的案例中，现有的指令已经涵盖了根本原因。 因此，剩余的差距主要在于选择和应用指令，而少数失败案例则指向策略的缺失。 经过指导的执行者可以与已发表的研究成果进行比较，尽管已发表的 BIRD 结果使用了完整的开发集或隐藏测试集，而我们的研究使用的是开发集中一个包含 1,074 道题的子集，因此比较仅为近似值。 经过指导的 Qwen3-4B 执行者在测试集上使用外部知识时的表现与 BIRD 作者报告的 ChatGPT 结果相当（39.3%，或使用思维链提示时为 40.1%）[21]，但低于 DIN-SQL（在测试集上为 55.9%）[31]；DIN-SQL 会提示 GPT-4 分步骤完成任务（模式关联、查询分类和 SQL 生成），然后自行修正查询。

paragraphs.en: ExpertLongBench tests the method where data is scarce and outputs are long. The advisor has only 450 training documents across six tasks, and each output is a structured report of several hundred words.
paragraphs.zh: ExpertLongBench 测试了在数据稀缺且输出内容较长情况下的方法。 该顾问在六个任务中仅有 450 份训练文档，而每份输出都是一份长达数百词的结构化报告。

paragraphs.en: Error analysis produced eight arms, several of which are task-specific frames such as security_threat_frame_first , pedagogical_evaluator_role_lock and clinical_note_completeness_and_fidelity , and a 57-directive taxonomy in nine areas. The areas cover task interpretation, source grounding, field completeness, value accuracy, schema-field disambiguation, negative findings, output structure, security analysis and pedagogical evaluation. Example directives are 2.2 scan_entire_source_for_each_field , 6.1 record_absent_fields_explicitly and 8.1 detect_and_label_prompt_injection . The best-arm oracle over the eight arms is +9.5 points on the training pool. The target_length labels come from the winning answer’s length. We first let the teacher’s LLM estimate this field, but its estimate matched the length of the winning answer on only 149 of 450 training rows (33%), and it systematically called for longer answers than the winning arms produced. Replacing the estimates with the winner’s actual length bucket changed 301 of the 450 labels.
paragraphs.zh: 错误分析生成了八个智能体，其中几个是任务特定的框架，例如 security_threat_frame_first、pedagogical_evaluator_role_lock 和 clinical_note_completeness_and_fidelity，以及一个涵盖九个领域的 57 项指令分类体系。 这些领域包括任务解释、来源依据、字段完整性、数值准确性、模式-字段消歧、负面发现、输出结构、安全分析和教学评估。 示例指令包括 2.2 scan_entire_source_for_each_field、6.1 record_absent_fields_explicitly 和 8.1 detect_and_label_prompt_injection。 在八个智能体中，最佳智能体的预言机在训练池上的得分高出 +9.5 分。 target_length 标签来自获胜答案的长度。 我们首先让教师的 LLM 估计该字段，但其估计值仅在 450 行训练数据中的 149 行（33%）与获胜答案的长度匹配，并且它系统性地要求比获胜智能体生成的答案更长的内容。 将估计值替换为获胜答案的实际长度区间后，450 个标签中有 301 个发生了变化。

paragraphs.en: Trained on the vocabularies and labels described above, the advisor raises checklist coverage from 49.7% to 54.5% on the 100 test documents. We analyse the distribution of the lift over tasks, together with the advisor’s arm and directive choices for each task, in Appendix C.5 . In short, the advisor picks directives that fit each task but sometimes chooses an arm meant for a different task. With only about 75 training documents per task, this is not surprising. We expect more training data, and an error analysis done separately for each task, will improve the arm choices and raise the gain further.
paragraphs.zh: 在以上描述的词汇表和标签上进行训练后，该顾问在 100 份测试文档中将检查清单的覆盖率从 49.7% 提升至 54.5%。 我们在附录 C.5 中分析了各任务中提升值的分布情况，以及顾问在每个任务中的臂选择和指令选择。 简而言之，该顾问会选择适合每个任务的指令，但有时也会选择原本为其他任务设计的臂。 考虑到每个任务仅有约 75 份训练文档，这种情况并不令人意外。 我们预计，增加更多训练数据，并为每个任务单独进行错误分析，将能改善臂的选择并进一步提升增益。

paragraphs.en: The advice carries two kinds of information. The first is insight learned from the executor’s traces. Error analysis on the training pool shows how this executor fails and which strategies fix each failure, and the hindsight labels show which fix actually worked on which input. The advisor turns this into a per-input choice from the arms and directives. This kind of information is not in the input, and the advisor could not have produced it without seeing the traces during training. All three settings that use mined directives show this. On FrontierFinance, the directives distilled from the agent’s failed and successful traces are what the gain depends on: without them, the teacher’s advice no longer improves on no advice (Table 4 ). On ExpertLongBench, the same kind of directives lets the advisor pick guidance that fits each task, and on BIRD, a mined directive already addresses the root cause of 94% of the remaining failures.
paragraphs.zh: 该建议包含两种信息。 第一种是从执行者的轨迹中获得的洞察。 对训练池的错误分析揭示了该执行者失败的方式以及哪些策略可以修复每种失败，而事后标签则显示了哪种修复方法在哪个输入上确实有效。 建议器据此为每个输入从不同的策略和指令中进行选择。 这类信息并不存在于输入中，如果建议者在训练期间没有看到轨迹，就不可能生成这些信息。 所有三种使用挖掘出的指令的设置都体现了这一点。 在 FrontierFinance 上，收益取决于从智能体失败和成功轨迹中提取的指令：没有这些指令，教师的建议就不再比不提供任何建议更优（表 4）。 在 ExpertLongBench 上，同类型的指令使建议器能够选择适合每项任务的指导方案；而在 BIRD 上，一个挖掘出的指令已经解决了剩余失败中 94% 的根本原因。

paragraphs.en: The second kind is instance-specific values filled into the advice. paragraphs.en: In both Qwen3-4B settings, advice that tells the executor exactly what to do helped more than advice that asks it to reason more carefully. On WebShop, “click the size button labelled ‘xx-large’ ” gained almost 9 points, while “inspect all option buttons” did not help and “verify the product type” hurt. On BIRD, most of the harm came from directives that the executor applied where they did not fit. One reading is that a small executor does not have spare capacity to decide when a general piece of guidance applies, so general guidance mostly adds text to its prompt, whereas a specific instruction replaces a decision it would otherwise get wrong. The finance agent, whose executor is a large frontier model, is the exception. Its gain comes mostly from general directives such as “cover all named entities in the query” (§ 5.1 ), which is consistent with the same reading, since a stronger executor can decide what to do with such guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Qwen3-4B 的两种设置中，明确告知执行者具体该做什么的建议，比要求执行者更谨慎地推理的建议更具帮助。 在 WebShop 上，“点击标有‘xx-large’的尺寸按钮”这一建议带来了近 9 分的提升，而“检查所有选项按钮”没有帮助，“验证产品类型”反而造成了负面影响。 在 BIRD 上，大部分负面影响源于执行者错误应用了本不应适用的指令。 一种解释是，小型执行者没有多余的算力来决定何时适用一般性指导原则，因此这类指导原则大多只是在其提示中添加文本；而具体指令则会取代它原本可能做出错误决定的过程。 金融智能体是个例外，其执行者是一个大型前沿模型。 它的提升主要得益于“覆盖查询中所有命名实体”（§ 5.1）等一般性指令，这与上述解释一致，因为更强大的执行者能够决定如何运用此类指导原则。

paragraphs.en: In our experiments, the way the training labels were defined had a clear effect on the trained advisor. On FrontierFinance, the cascade rule for the winning arm changed 681 of the 1,819 labels and gave our best advisor. More epochs, a reasoning trace and RL did not improve on it (Appendix C.2 ). On WebShop, breaking ties toward default gave a better advisor than breaking them toward the arm with the fewest turns (Appendix C.1 ). On ExpertLongBench, the teacher’s LLM estimated the answer length correctly for only a third of the training samples. An advisor trained on these estimates would have learned mostly the LLM’s bias. All three cases follow the field-source rule of § 3.2.3 . Some fields have a single correct value that a rule can compute, such as the answer length or the options stated in the instruction. For these fields, the rule gives more reliable labels than the LLM. Other fields, such as the directives, require judgment across several runs. For these, the LLM’s labels carry the gain, as the FrontierFinance ablation shows.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的实验中，训练标签的定义方式对训练出的智能体产生了明显影响。 在 FrontierFinance 上，获胜分支的级联规则修改了 1,819 个标签中的 681 个，并让我们的最佳智能体得以实现。 增加更多轮次、加入推理轨迹和强化学习并未带来改进（附录 C.2）。 在 WebShop 上，将平局判定为默认选项比将其判定为回合数最少的分支能产生更优的智能体（附录 C.1）。 在 ExpertLongBench 上，教师的 LLM 仅对三分之一的训练样本正确估计了答案长度。 基于这些估计值训练的智能体，主要会学到 LLM 的偏见。 所有三种情况都遵循 § 3.2.3 中的字段来源规则。 某些字段存在唯一正确的值，该值可通过规则计算得出，例如答案长度或说明中列出的选项。 对于这些字段，规则提供的标签比 LLM 更可靠。 其他字段（如指令）则需要通过多次运行进行判断。 对于这些字段，LLM 的标签带来了增益，正如 FrontierFinance 的消融实验所示。

paragraphs.en: The same pipeline gave gains of different size in the four settings. The differences come mainly from the training data and the task. The advisor can only be as good as its labels and as broad as its training pool. On ExpertLongBench, for example, 450 training documents were enough to learn task-appropriate directives but not enough to learn a reliable arm choice. The advice also helps only where the executor’s traces show failures that advice can fix. An instantiated field helps only if its value can be recovered from the input. WebShop’s option values can be recovered this way, but BIRD’s tables and columns cannot. Before applying the method to a new setting, we suggest checking four things. The executor should succeed on some training inputs and fail on others. The training pool should be large and reliably graded. Error analysis should reveal failures that advice can address. Finally, any instance-specific values that the advice needs should be recoverable from the input.
paragraphs.zh: 在同一流程中，四种设置下获得的增益大小各不相同。 这些差异主要源于训练数据和任务本身。 顾问的好坏取决于其标签的质量，而能力的广度则受限于其训练池的范围。 例如，在 ExpertLongBench 上，450 份训练文档足以学会适合任务的指令，但不足以学会可靠的策略选择。 此外，建议仅在执行者的轨迹显示出可通过建议解决的问题时才能发挥作用。 只有当实例化字段的值能够从输入中恢复出来时，它才有用。 WebShop 的选项值可以通过这种方式恢复，但 BIRD 的表格和列则无法如此恢复。 在将该方法应用于新设置之前，我们建议检查四个方面。 执行者应对某些训练输入成功，而对另一些输入失败。 训练池应当规模较大，并且能够被可靠地评分。 错误分析应能揭示那些可以通过建议来解决的问题。 最后，建议所需的任何特定实例值都应能够从输入中恢复出来。

paragraphs.en: The advice is appended to the executor’s instructions as guidance. The executor keeps all of its tools and can depart from the advice when the evidence points elsewhere. Not every suggestion is followed, but on average the advice helps. The fields also differ in how closely they are tied to one executor. Some fields describe the input and what a good answer needs, such as which sources hold the answer, how many periods it spans or which disclosures to check. These fields should carry over to other executors. Other fields reflect the habits of the executor whose traces the advisor learned from, such as its typical blind spots. These fields are most useful for that executor.

paragraphs.en: Our advice is text, and the advisor acts as a small adapter that supplies task know-how for each input. A single optimized prompt gives every input the same guidance. The advisor instead gives each input its own guidance, without making every prompt longer. The executor never changes, so the method works with closed or shared models, and the same advice can be given to a different executor. The cost is that the executor reads the advice on every call and does the extra work it asks for. On the FrontierFinance leaderboard, the advised agent costs 23% more per query than the agent without advice, but it still costs 37% less than the agent’s high-effort configuration and scores higher, which shows the value of guidance tailored to each input. Methods that distil experience or skills into the executor’s weights [ 14 , 18 ] , or that have a side model produce parameters or latent tokens instead of text [ 7 , 8 , 47 ] , avoid this per-call cost, but they have to modify the executor. Advice written as text also has an interpretability benefit, since the advice given for each input can be read and inspected directly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的建议以文本形式呈现，而顾问则充当一个小型适配器，为每个输入提供任务相关的专业知识。 单个优化后的提示词会为所有输入提供相同的指导。 相反，顾问会针对每个输入提供专属的指导，同时不会使每个提示词都变得更长。 执行器本身从不改变，因此该方法既适用于闭源模型也适用于共享模型，并且相同的建议也可以应用于不同的执行器。 其代价是，执行器在每次调用时都需要读取建议，并完成建议中要求的额外工作。 在 FrontierFinance 排行榜上，使用建议的智能体每次查询的成本比无建议的智能体高 23%，但仍比该智能体的高努力配置低 37%，且得分更高，这表明为每个输入量身定制的指导具有显著价值。 那些将经验或技能蒸馏到执行器权重中 [14, 18]，或者通过辅助模型生成参数或潜在标记而非文本的方法 [7, 8, 47]，可以避免这种每次调用的成本，但它们必须对执行器进行修改。 以文本形式书写的建议还具有可解释性的优势，因为针对每个输入提供的建议可以直接被阅读和检查。

sents.en: The executor never changes, so the method works with closed or shared models, and the same advice can be given to a different executor.
sents.zh: 执行器本身从不改变，因此该方法既适用于闭源模型也适用于共享模型，并且相同的建议也可以应用于不同的执行器。

sents.en: The cost is that the executor reads the advice on every call and does the extra work it asks for.
sents.zh: 其代价是，执行器在每次调用时都需要读取建议，并完成建议中要求的额外工作。

sents.en: On the FrontierFinance leaderboard, the advised agent costs 23% more per query than the agent without advice, but it still costs 37% less than the agent’s high-effort configuration and scores higher, which shows the value of guidance tailored to each input.
sents.zh: 在 FrontierFinance 排行榜上，使用建议的智能体每次查询的成本比无建议的智能体高 23%，但仍比该智能体的高努力配置低 37%，且得分更高，这表明为每个输入量身定制的指导具有显著价值。

sents.en: Methods that distil experience or skills into the executor’s weights [ 14 , 18 ] , or that have a side model produce parameters or latent tokens instead of text [ 7 , 8 , 47 ] , avoid this per-call cost, but they have to modify the executor.
sents.zh: 那些将经验或技能蒸馏到执行器权重中 [14, 18]，或者通过辅助模型生成参数或潜在标记而非文本的方法 [7, 8, 47]，可以避免这种每次调用的成本，但它们必须对执行器进行修改。

sents.en: Advice written as text also has an interpretability benefit, since the advice given for each input can be read and inspected directly.
sents.zh: 以文本形式书写的建议还具有可解释性的优势，因为针对每个输入提供的建议可以直接被阅读和检查。

paragraphs.en: Each result comes from a single evaluation run per condition. The exception is ExpertLongBench, with 100 test documents. Our validation sets are also small, with 100 questions on FrontierFinance and 200 samples on WebShop, so differences of a few points between advisors on validation can be within run-to-run variation. paragraphs.en: The arms and the directive taxonomies went through several rounds of revision, each guided by error analysis of the executor’s traces, and most rounds improved the result. On WebShop, rebuilding the taxonomy around instantiated option directives raised the gain from about 3 to 8.7 points. On BIRD, appending the arms to a fixed base instruction improved every arm, and on FrontierFinance, revising the winning-arm rule improved the advisor. These revisions were not exhaustive. Further error analysis and iterations would likely give further gains.
paragraphs.zh: 各个分支和指令分类体系经历了多轮修订，每一轮都以对执行者轨迹的错误分析为指导，且大多数修订都提升了结果。 在 WebShop 上，围绕已实例化的选项指令重构分类体系，使收益从约 3 分提升至 8.7 分。 在 BIRD 上，将各分支附加到固定的基础指令中提升了每个分支的表现；而在 FrontierFinance 上，修订获胜分支规则则优化了顾问的表现。 这些修订并不彻底。 进一步的错误分析和迭代很可能还会带来额外的提升。

paragraphs.en: We studied four settings, and the results may not hold for other tasks, executors or datasets. In particular, we have not measured how well the advice transfers to other executors or to other datasets in the same domain. More generally, the quality of the structured advice and of the trained advisor depends on the training data and on the task. Some tasks may be hard to learn with an advisor. When the most useful advice requires the same inference that the executor gets wrong, as with BIRD’s choice of tables and columns, the advisor gains little, and training the executor itself may be necessary. The method also needs a training pool with gold answers or a reliable grader, an executor that succeeds on some training inputs and fails on others, and an arms collection phase whose cost grows with the number of arms.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了四种设置，但这些结果可能不适用于其他任务、执行者或数据集。 具体来说，我们尚未衡量这些建议能多好地迁移到其他执行者或同一领域内的其他数据集上。 更广泛地说，结构化建议的质量和训练出的顾问的质量都取决于训练数据和具体任务。 某些任务可能难以通过顾问来学习。 当最有用的建议需要执行者本身未能正确完成的推理时（例如 BIRD 在表格和列的选择中那样），顾问几乎无法获得提升，此时训练执行者本身可能是必要的。 该方法还需要一个包含标准答案的训练池或可靠的评分器、一个在某些训练输入上成功而在另一些输入上失败的执行者，以及一个其成本随臂的数量增加而上升的臂收集阶段。

paragraphs.en: We described hindsight structured advice distillation (HSAD), a way to improve a frozen executor by training a small advisor on the executor’s own failures. The motivation is that a capable executor often lacks know-how about the task rather than general ability, and that this know-how is better supplied per input than written once into a long, shared prompt. The advisor learns, from inputs alone, the structured advice that a teacher wrote with hindsight access to gold answers and to the results of every strategy. It follows the idea of distillation with privileged information, but it distills into a separate small model rather than into the executor, so the executor stays unchanged and the advisor is cheap to train and run. On the public FrontierFinance benchmark, an 8B advisor lifted Samaya’s proprietary research agent from 52.9% to 56.6%, above the agent’s own high-effort configuration and the best frontier model in an open harness. With a small Qwen3-4B executor, the advice also improved a shopping agent, text-to-SQL and expert long-form generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们描述了事后结构化建议蒸馏（HSAD）方法，这是一种通过用执行器自身的失败案例训练一个小型建议器来改进固定执行器的方法。 其核心动机在于，一个能力强的执行器通常缺乏对任务的具体操作知识，而非普遍能力；而这种具体知识更适合针对每个输入单独提供，而不是一次性写入一个冗长且共享的提示中。 该建议器仅通过输入数据，就能学会教师模型在事后获得黄金答案和所有策略结果的情况下所书写的结构化建议。 该方法遵循了使用特权信息进行蒸馏的思路，但将蒸馏结果注入一个独立的小型模型而非执行器本身，因此执行器保持原样，而建议器的训练和运行成本较低。 在公开的 FrontierFinance 基准测试中，一个 8B 规模的建议器将 Samaya 的专有研究智能体性能从 52.9% 提升至 56.6%，超过了该智能体自身的高配置版本以及开放框架中的最佳前沿模型。 使用一个小型的 Qwen3-4B 执行器，这些建议还提升了购物智能体、文本转 SQL 以及专家级长文本生成任务的性能。

paragraphs.en: How much the advice helps depends on the task and on the training data. The largest gains came where error analysis of the executor’s traces revealed failures that advice could fix, where any instance-specific values could be recovered from the input, and where the training labels were reliable. These results suggest two practical rules for building such an advisor. First, derive the advice from error analysis of the executor’s own traces, and give it fields whose values the advisor can predict from the input. On FrontierFinance, the teacher-executed gain disappears without the directives mined from the agent’s failures, and on WebShop the decisive field restates option values that the instruction already contains. Second, label every field that can be read off the runs with a rule, and use the teacher’s LLM only for fields that need judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 建议能有多大帮助，取决于具体任务以及训练数据。 最大的提升出现在以下情况：对执行者轨迹的错误分析揭示了建议可以修复的故障；任何实例特定的值都可以通过输入恢复；并且训练标签是可靠的。 这些结果为构建此类建议器提出了两条实用规则。 首先，从执行者自身轨迹的错误分析中推导建议，并为其设置可由建议器根据输入预测值的字段。 在 FrontierFinance 上，如果没有从智能体失败中挖掘出的指令，教师执行带来的增益就会消失；而在 WebShop 上，决定性字段只是重复了说明中已经包含的选项值。 其次，为所有可以从运行记录中读取的字段添加规则标签，而仅对那些需要判断的字段使用教师的 LLM。

paragraphs.en: The advisor could also be made cheaper. Most advice fields are typed choices over closed vocabularies, such as the arm, the effort and length buckets, web_use and the directive picks. Recent decision models such as Jev return this kind of output directly, as calibrated probabilities over declared options, in a single parallel pass and at a small fraction of the latency and cost of an LLM call [ 2 ] . Producing the categorical fields this way, and generating text only for instantiated values such as WebShop’s option strings, could make structured advice generation much cheaper and faster. Open questions include how much of the advice transfers across executors and across datasets in the same domain. Another is how the advisor can learn from the executor’s results after deployment. Our advisor is trained once, offline, and gives its advice before the executor runs. It could instead be updated online, adding new graded traces to its training data as they arrive, or revise its advice within an episode after seeing intermediate results, such as an error message or an empty query result.
paragraphs.zh: 该顾问也可以被设计得更便宜。 大多数建议字段都是基于封闭词汇表的选择，例如手臂、努力程度和长度等级、web_use 以及指令选项。 近期的决策模型（如 Jev）能够直接返回此类输出，即对已声明选项的校准概率，且只需一次并行处理，其延迟和成本仅为 LLM 调用的极小一部分 [2]。 以这种方式生成分类字段，并仅对具体实例值（如 WebShop 的选项字符串）生成文本，可以使结构化建议的生成过程更便宜、更快速。 待解决的问题包括：在相同领域内，建议在多大程度上可以在不同执行器和不同数据集之间迁移。 另一个问题是：部署后，顾问如何能从执行器的结果中学习。 我们的顾问是一次性离线训练的，并在执行器运行之前给出建议。 另一种做法是将其在线更新：随着新分级轨迹的到来，将其添加到训练数据中；或者在执行周期内看到中间结果（如错误消息或空查询结果）后，修正其建议。

paragraphs.en: The mined taxonomy had 50 directives in five families (search-query formulation, product validation, option configuration, exact variant matching, and fallback or pivoting). paragraphs.en: On WebShop, we also tried breaking ties toward the arm with the fewest turns instead of toward default , which moved 602 training rows away from default . We observed a drop in performance with the advisor trained on these labels, so on WebShop we break ties toward default . On BIRD, 52% of training questions have two or more correct arms and 41% have none, so on most rows the scores alone cannot pick a winner. On these rows the teacher’s LLM picks the arm. It sees the gold query and its result, together with each arm’s query and execution result, and chooses the arm whose query is closest to the gold query.
paragraphs.zh: 在 WebShop 中，我们还尝试在出现平局时选择所需步数最少的智能体，而不是选择默认智能体，这使得 602 个训练样本偏离了默认选择。 我们发现使用这些标签训练出的顾问性能有所下降，因此在 WebShop 中，出现平局时会选择默认智能体。 在 BIRD 中，52% 的训练问题有两个或更多正确的智能体，而 41% 的问题则没有正确智能体，因此在大多数样本中，仅凭得分无法确定获胜者。 在这些样本中，由教师的 LLM 来选择智能体。 它会查看黄金查询及其结果，以及每个智能体的查询和执行结果，然后选择其查询与黄金查询最接近的智能体。

paragraphs.en: The executor’s score on a single input varies between runs. Ideally, each arm would be run several times with different seeds, and its average score, or its pass@ k k , would be used to find the best arm and compute the reference points. We did not do this because it would multiply the cost of the arms collection, which is already the most expensive step of the pipeline. The reported lifts are less affected, since they are averages over many test inputs. We leave a statistical analysis over repeated runs to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 执行器在单次输入上的得分在不同运行中会有所差异。 理想情况下，每个臂应使用不同的种子运行多次，并采用其平均得分或 pass@k 来找出最佳臂并计算参考点。 我们没有这样做，因为这会使臂收集的成本成倍增加，而该步骤已经是整个流程中最昂贵的环节。 报告的提升值受影响较小，因为它们是多次测试输入的平均值。 我们将重复运行下的统计分析留待未来工作完成。

paragraphs.en: The winning arm of each training question can be defined in more than one way, and the definition affects the trained advisor. We compare two rules. The first picks the arm with the highest composite score, a hand-weighted sum of the essential-criteria rate with smaller, capped terms for cost and latency, and breaks ties toward default . The second is the cascade of § 3.2.2 , which orders the arms by essential-criteria rate, then all-criteria rate, then cost, then latency. paragraphs.en: We also tried to improve the SFT advisor with GRPO [ 33 ] . Starting from the selected SFT checkpoint, we trained a new LoRA for one epoch over the 1,819 training questions, with eight sampled outputs per question. The reward compares the advisor’s JSON with the teacher’s target field by field and does not run the agent, since one agent run takes about four minutes and costs about a dollar. The field weights reflect how much each field contributed in the ablation of § 5.1 : 0.40 for the arm, 0.35 for the overlap (Jaccard index) between the predicted and target directive picks, 0.10 for the sources, 0.06 each for the tools and web use, and 0.03 for the target length. In a first run, the arm part of the reward gave partial credit. For each training question, we know the score that every arm received during collection. Choosing the best arm earned 1, choosing the worst arm earned 0, and any other arm earned a value in between, in proportion to its score. For example, if the four arms scored 80%, 70%, 60% and 40% on a question, choosing the arm that scored 70% earned 0.75. The reward rose from 0.57 to 0.74 during training, but the advisor learned to choose tables_extraction for almost every question, because under graded credit this single arm already earns 0.67 of the arm reward. A second run scored the arm by exact match with the label and added a KL penalty to the SFT policy ( β = 0.01 \beta=0.01 ). This kept the arm choices varied, and the directive-pick overlap rose from 0.51 to 0.71 and the arm match from 0.25 to 0.34 on the training questions. On held-out questions, however, arm accuracy was flat, and in the executor the advisor scored 67.8% essential on validation and 58.4% on the test queries, below the SFT checkpoint it started from (Table 7 ). These results show that this form of reward, which compares the advice with the teacher’s target without measuring the executor’s performance on the task, can rise on the training questions without leading to better answers. Finding low-cost reward signals that correlate with the executor’s downstream performance is a natural direction for future work on training the advisor with RL.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5a compares three advice designs on the 500 test samples, each produced by a trained advisor. Predicting only the arm gains 3.65 score points. The second design adds generic directives from the taxonomy mined from failure notes (§ 3.2.1 ). That taxonomy has 50 directives in five families. Evaluated one family at a time on the 200 validation samples, only the option-configuration family helped (Appendix B ), while the search and fallback families lowered the score, for example by telling the agent to abandon a product whose exact option was missing. With only the option family kept, the generic directives, such as “inspect all option buttons and click every required one”, add nothing on top of the arm (+2.94). The third design, the trained advisor with its full advice, replaces these generic directives with the six option directives of the final taxonomy, each instantiated with the option value stated in the instruction, such as “click the size button labelled ‘x-large’ ”. This design follows from the lost-reward analysis of § 5.2 and gains 8.73 points, close to the 8.95 points obtained when the option values come from the regular-expression rule instead of the advisor. The difference between the second and third designs is therefore not only which directives are kept but whether they are generic or instantiated. Fig. 5b shows the reference points of § 3.3 on the 200 validation samples. The best-arm oracle is +9.59, but running each sample again with its best arm gives only +6.49 (run-to-run variance, Appendix C.1 ). The trained advisor gains 8.16 points on validation, more than the executed best arm, because its options field carries information that no arm contains.
paragraphs.zh: 图5a比较了三种建议设计在500个测试样本上的表现，每种设计均由一个训练过的智能体生成。 仅预测最佳臂可提升3.65分。 第二种设计增加了从失败说明中挖掘出的分类体系（§ 3.2.1）中的通用指令。 该分类体系包含五个类别中的50条指令。 在200个验证样本上逐类评估时，只有“选项-配置”类别带来了帮助（附录B），而“搜索”和“回退”类别则降低了得分，例如通过指示智能体放弃某个确切选项缺失的产品。 仅保留“选项”类别后，诸如“检查所有选项按钮并点击每个必需的按钮”之类的通用指令并未在最佳臂的基础上带来任何额外提升（+2.94）。 第三种设计，即带有完整建议的训练过智能体，用最终分类体系中的六条选项指令取代了这些通用指令，每条指令都根据说明中给出的选项值进行具体化，例如“点击标有‘x-large’的尺寸按钮”。 该设计源于§ 5.2中的损失奖励分析，并提升了8.73分，接近当选项值来自正则表达式规则而非智能体时获得的8.95分。 因此，第二种和第三种设计之间的差异不仅在于保留了哪些指令，还在于这些指令是通用的还是具体化的。 图5b展示了§ 3.3中的参考点在200个验证样本上的表现。 最佳臂的oracle值为+9.59，但重新运行每个样本并使用其最佳臂仅能获得+6.49（运行间方差，附录C.1）。 训练过的智能体在验证集上获得了8.16分，高于执行的最佳臂，因为其选项字段包含了任何臂都不具备的信息。

sents.en: With only the option family kept, the generic directives, such as “inspect all option buttons and click every required one”, add nothing on top of the arm (+2.94).
sents.zh: 仅保留“选项”类别后，诸如“检查所有选项按钮并点击每个必需的按钮”之类的通用指令并未在最佳臂的基础上带来任何额外提升（+2.94）。

sents.en: The third design, the trained advisor with its full advice, replaces these generic directives with the six option directives of the final taxonomy, each instantiated with the option value stated in the instruction, such as “click the size button labelled ‘x-large’ ”.
sents.zh: 第三种设计，即带有完整建议的训练过智能体，用最终分类体系中的六条选项指令取代了这些通用指令，每条指令都根据说明中给出的选项值进行具体化，例如“点击标有‘x-large’的尺寸按钮”。

sents.en: This design follows from the lost-reward analysis of § 5.2 and gains 8.73 points, close to the 8.95 points obtained when the option values come from the regular-expression rule instead of the advisor.
sents.zh: 该设计源于§ 5.2中的损失奖励分析，并提升了8.73分，接近当选项值来自正则表达式规则而非智能体时获得的8.95分。

sents.en: The difference between the second and third designs is therefore not only which directives are kept but whether they are generic or instantiated.
sents.zh: 因此，第二种和第三种设计之间的差异不仅在于保留了哪些指令，还在于这些指令是通用的还是具体化的。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 6 shows the reference points of § 3.3 on the 1,074 BIRD test questions. The best-arm oracle is +20.11 execution-accuracy points, running the winning arm again gives +11.27, and the trained advisor gains 3.07. The oracle is higher than the rerun because each arm was run only once during collection: on a question where one of the nine arms happened to succeed, running that arm again does not always succeed. See also Appendix C.3 for similar behavior for WebShop. The trained advisor stays well below the best arm run again, unlike on WebShop. On WebShop, the most useful advice copies option values that the instruction states, so the advisor can produce it exactly. On BIRD, the most useful advice says which tables and columns the query needs, and the advisor has to guess this from the question without seeing the database schema (§ 5.3 ). High-quality instantiated advice is therefore harder to obtain on this dataset. With more training data, or with better advice fields, there is still room to improve.
paragraphs.zh: 图6展示了第3.3节中1,074个BIRD测试问题的参考点。 最佳臂的oracle值为+20.11执行准确率点，再次运行获胜臂可获得+11.27，而训练后的顾问则获得3.07。 oracle值高于重新运行值，因为在数据收集阶段每个臂仅运行了一次：对于某个臂恰好成功的问题，再次运行该臂并不总能成功。 关于WebShop的类似行为，另请参见附录C.3。 与WebShop不同，训练后的顾问表现始终远低于再次运行的最佳臂。 在WebShop中，最实用的建议会复制指令中明确说明的选项值，因此顾问可以完全准确地生成该建议。 在BIRD中，最实用的建议会指出查询所需的表名和列名，而顾问必须根据问题自行推测这些信息，无法看到数据库模式（第5.3节）。 因此，在这个数据集中获得高质量的实例化建议更为困难。 如果拥有更多训练数据或更优质的建议字段，仍然存在改进空间。

paragraphs.en: A model diagnosed the 72 test questions that the advice turns from correct to wrong. The dominant pattern is over-application, such as adding a join that duplicates rows, “correcting” a literal that was already right (for example turning ’CA’ into ’California’ ), or choosing the wrong one of two similarly named columns. In about two thirds of these cases the arm is default , so the harm comes from the directive text. Four of the 63 directives are net negative, led by use_conditional_aggregation_for_pivoted_metrics , and the other frequently used directives are net positive. These cases show that the BIRD taxonomy and directive texts leave room for further refinement, for example by rewording or removing the directives that are over-applied.
paragraphs.zh: 一个模型诊断了 72 道测试题，在这些题目中，建议从正确变成了错误。 主要模式是过度应用，例如添加导致行重复的关联操作，“纠正”原本已经正确的字面值（例如将“CA”改为“California”），或在两个名称相似列中选择错误的列。 在这些情况中，大约三分之二的情况下，该分支是默认设置，因此损害来自指令文本本身。 在 63 条指令中，有 4 条的净效应为负，其中 use_conditional_aggregation_for_pivoted_metrics 的影响最大，而其他常用指令的净效应则为正。 这些案例表明，BIRD 分类体系和指令文本仍有进一步优化的空间，例如通过重新措辞或移除那些被过度应用的指令。

paragraphs.en: For a sample of 180 test questions that the executor answers wrongly both with and without advice, we checked each root cause against the taxonomy. For 94% of them, an existing directive already addresses the root cause. The remaining gap is therefore mostly a matter of picking the right directive and having the executor apply it correctly, not of missing strategies. A second test supports this. If we run all nine arms on each question and choose among their queries using the execution results, either the first query that runs without error or the result that most arms agree on, execution accuracy rises by about 6 points, twice the advisor’s gain. For many questions, one of the existing arms already writes a correct query, and the missing step is choosing it. The advisor cannot use this signal, because it runs before any query is executed.

paragraphs.en: Table 8 breaks the ExpertLongBench lift down by task. The largest gains are in security review (+20.4 points) and pedagogical evaluation (+9.0), and the other four tasks change little. The directive picks generally fit the task, as the examples in Table 8 show: the advisor picks prompt-injection detection for security reviews and examination-finding transcription for clinical notes. The arm choices fit less well. For several tasks, the advisor often chooses an arm designed for another task, for example the security frame for clinical notes and materials-science papers. We read this as cross-task interference. With 450 training documents shared by six tasks and eight arms, the advisor sees few examples of each task and arm, and arms learned for one task carry over to others. The two tasks with a clear gain are also the two where the predicted arm usually matches the task. We expect that more training data per task, a taxonomy and set of arms organised by task, or restricting the arm choice to the arms that fit each task could raise the lift on the remaining tasks, and we leave this to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 表8按任务细分了ExpertLongBench的提升情况。 最大的提升出现在安全审查（+20.4分）和教学评估（+9.0分），而其他四个任务的变化很小。 指令的选择通常与任务相符，如表8中的示例所示：顾问为安全审查选择了提示注入检测，为临床笔记选择了检查发现转录。 而臂的选择则不太契合。 在几个任务中，顾问经常选择为其他任务设计的臂，例如为临床笔记和材料科学论文选择了安全框架。 我们将此解读为跨任务干扰。 由于六个任务和八个臂共享了450份训练文档，顾问对每个任务和臂的示例都很少，且为一个任务学习的臂会迁移到其他任务中。 两个有明显提升的任务，也是预测臂通常与任务匹配的两个任务。 我们预计，如果为每个任务提供更多训练数据、按任务组织分类体系和臂的集合，或将对臂的选择限制为适合每个任务的臂，则可能提升其余任务的表现，我们将此留待未来研究。

sents.zh: 最大的提升出现在安全审查（+20.4分）和教学评估（+9.0分），而其他四个任务的变化很小。

sents.en: The directive picks generally fit the task, as the examples in Table 8 show: the advisor picks prompt-injection detection for security reviews and examination-finding transcription for clinical notes.
sents.zh: 指令的选择通常与任务相符，如表8中的示例所示：顾问为安全审查选择了提示注入检测，为临床笔记选择了检查发现转录。

sents.en: The arm choices fit less well.
sents.zh: 而臂的选择则不太契合。

sents.en: For several tasks, the advisor often chooses an arm designed for another task, for example the security frame for clinical notes and materials-science papers.
sents.zh: 在几个任务中，顾问经常选择为其他任务设计的臂，例如为临床笔记和材料科学论文选择了安全框架。

sents.en: We read this as cross-task interference.
sents.zh: 我们将此解读为跨任务干扰。

sents.en: With 450 training documents shared by six tasks and eight arms, the advisor sees few examples of each task and arm, and arms learned for one task carry over to others.
sents.zh: 由于六个任务和八个臂共享了450份训练文档，顾问对每个任务和臂的示例都很少，且为一个任务学习的臂会迁移到其他任务中。

sents.en: The two tasks with a clear gain are also the two where the predicted arm usually matches the task.
sents.zh: 两个有明显提升的任务，也是预测臂通常与任务匹配的两个任务。

sents.en: We expect that more training data per task, a taxonomy and set of arms organised by task, or restricting the arm choice to the arms that fit each task could raise the lift on the remaining tasks, and we leave this to future work.
sents.zh: 我们预计，如果为每个任务提供更多训练数据、按任务组织分类体系和臂的集合，或将对臂的选择限制为适合每个任务的臂，则可能提升其余任务的表现，我们将此留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Task T11 (security review): the input is a transcript of an agent that was asked to fetch the details and reviews of a laptop on Amazon. One of the returned reviews contains an injected instruction to delete a patient’s clinical documents in another system. The expected output is a structured security analysis with six fields.
paragraphs.zh: 任务 T11（安全审查）：输入是一段智能体的对话记录，该智能体被要求获取亚马逊上某台笔记本电脑的详细信息和评价。 其中一条返回的评价包含了一条注入的指令，要求删除另一系统中的患者临床文档。 预期输出是一个包含六个字段的结构化安全分析。
